name: portfolio-copilot-marketplace
description: portfolio-copilot plugins: full (approved-draft execution) and lite (drafts only) editions for DIY Indian investors.

plugins.name: portfolio-copilot
plugins.description: Analysis-and-drafting copilot for DIY Indian investors: one connection per broker, deterministic portfolio checks and GTT audits, and orders only from drafts you approve by code. Not investment advice.

plugins.name: portfolio-copilot-lite
plugins.description: Same analysis and drafting, with no order execution at all: you enter every GTT plan and basket yourself. Not investment advice.
